spec_architectural_decisions.decision: POST /api/internal/zoho/sync accepts caller-supplied TenantId in the request body behind shared-secret authentication only; no JWT or service identity binding.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q-approved during interview (Adim 3 P1 batch, 'Shared secret + header check - Recommended'). Sole legitimate caller is Invekto.Backend lifecycle hook which knows tenant context server-side; shared secret is the single trust boundary. Standing up per-service JWT would exceed Adim 3 P1 scope and the codebase currently has no service-identity issuing authority.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ1/CQ9/Q2 may flag that body.TenantId is caller-controlled after shared-secret auth. This is an accepted architectural decision for Adim 3 P1 — not a regression. Cross-tenant risk is acknowledged and bounded to shared-secret compromise; rotation is operational.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: POST /api/internal/zoho/sync always returns HTTP 200 with body.Status in {success,failed}; mapping/blueprint absence does not surface as 4xx/5xx at the HTTP layer.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: zoho_sync_log is the source of truth. Treating expected business failures (missing mapping, missing blueprint, missing transition) as 200 + body.Status=failed lets the retry worker and Dashboard badge treat sync_log as the single authoritative lifecycle instead of reconstructing state from HTTP status classes.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: endpoint returns 200 for business failures; ErrorCode is carried in the body (INV-INT-120/121/122/123/125). Only validation (400 INV-GEN-003) and internal-auth (401/403/500 INV-INT-124) produce non-200. Not a silent success: body.Success=false + ErrorCode populated.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Shared DTO properties use PascalCase (Invekto.Shared convention); wire format is handled by each service's default System.Text.Json casing policy at the service boundary.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Matches existing Shared contract style (e.g. Invekto.Shared.Contracts.Inma.Dtos.WapCrmInstanceDto). Consumers in Adim 3 P2 (Backend) and P3 (Dashboard) will respect the same serializer policy already used across /api/v1/ endpoints.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: shared DTO PascalCase is the established codebase convention, not a new pattern.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Typed HttpClient services (ZohoBlueprintClient, ZohoLeadClient) are registered via AddHttpClient<T>(...) PLUS AddSingleton<IT>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<T>()) singleton wrapper.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Mirrors the existing pattern already used by ZohoTokenProvider in Invekto.Integrations/Program.cs (Adim 2 Paket B, merged to master). Handler lifetime is still managed by IHttpClientFactory; only the thin wrapper class is captured. Changing it would diverge from the service-wide convention.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ5 may flag singleton typed-client registration; this is the in-use project convention (see ZohoTokenProvider in the same service).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ZohoStageMappingDto/ZohoStageMappingUpsertRequest/ZohoSyncRequest/ZohoSyncResponse/ZohoSyncFailedCountResponse/ZohoStageMappingListResponse are NEW shared contracts introduced in this packet and have no prior consumer outside Invekto.Integrations.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Adim 3 P2 (Backend->Integrations HTTP call) and P3 (Dashboard UI) are explicitly out of scope for P1 and will land in subsequent packets. There is nothing to 'break' because the contract is newborn — the only consumer in this packet is Invekto.Integrations' own endpoint layer which is updated in the same diff.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ8 may treat DTO signature changes (e.g. removing TenantId from ZohoStageMappingUpsertRequest) as breaking; they are not breaking because no consumer exists yet. P2 and P3 will consume the final shape.

aha_moments.suggestion: Mapping tablosunda kayit yokken sync endpoint'i INV-INT-120 ile aciklayici mesaj doner, P3 UI bu hata kodunu yakalayip 'Stage mapping eksik' banner gosterir.

aha_moments.user_pain: Zoho API intermittent fail'de veri kaybi olur, hangi lead'ler sync olmadi bilinmez.
aha_moments.suggestion: Her sync denemesi zoho_sync_log'a attempt_count+last_error ile yazilir. P2 retry worker 3x'e kadar tekrar dener, P3 UI fail listesi gosterir.

aha_moments.user_pain: Destek ekibi 'niye bu lead Zoho'ya gitmedi?' sorusuna cevap bulamaz.

aha_moments.aha_moment: Destek 30 saniyede 'Blueprint transition ID degismis, mapping guncelle' der - sorun cozulur.

aha_moments.user_pain: Blueprint discovery her sync'te GET /blueprint cagrisi yapsa Zoho rate limit'e takilir.
aha_moments.suggestion: ZohoBlueprintClient in-memory IMemoryCache ile blueprint metadata'yi 10 dk cache'ler (per tenant).
aha_moments.aha_moment: 1000 lead'lik batch sync'te Zoho API cagrisi 1000+10 yerine 1000'de kalir - 10x hizli.

aha_moments.user_pain: Satis musterisi 'Zoho ile nasil senkron tutarsiniz?' sorusuna canli demo ister.
aha_moments.suggestion: POST /api/internal/zoho/sync endpoint'i Swagger'da dokumente, orneksel payload + response. Satis demo sirasinda Postman'dan cagri + Zoho UI'da anlik stage degisimi gosterir.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Prospect '30 saniyede stage otomatik guncellendi' der, deal guven kazanir.

verdict.raw_text: Q FORCE PASS override after 4 Codex iterations. Iter 0->1->2->3 progressively fixed: tenant-scoped GetAsync, typed catches, Blueprint pre-check, partial unique index + atomic ON CONFLICT upsert, INV-INT-125 sync infrastructure code, INV-INT-126 auth-not-configured code, INV-GEN-003 prefix on validation errors, scope-creep cleanup, JSON parse coverage in ZohoLeadClient. Remaining iter-3 blockers were architectural (CQ9/Q2: shared-secret + body.TenantId for /api/internal/zoho/sync) — explicitly Q-approved and documented in spec_architectural_decisions; Codex policy refuses to accept the decision so Q exercised override per workflow Q overrides table. All COVE Q1/Q3/Q4 PASS. Build PASS. Risk accepted: shared-secret compromise grants cross-tenant sync ability — bounded by InternalServices:SharedSecret rotation policy.
